description.value: Jackknife Brewing is a punk-metal-inspired craft brewery and pizzeria in Kelowna, BC, celebrated for experimental beers brewed with centuries-old Nordic Kveik farmhouse yeasts and locally foraged ingredients like spruce tips, juniper, and wild berries — earning a World Beer Cup silver in 2024. The space doubles as an intimate live music venue they call 'the dungeon,' hosting regular metal and rock shows. Touring cyclists can refuel on classic New York-style pizza alongside creative, award-winning ales.

address.value: 727 Baillie Ave, Kelowna, BC V1Y 7E9, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Jackknife Brewing is an active brewery and pizzeria in Kelowna, BC, with upcoming live shows listed through August 2026 and a current tap list — clearly open and operating. The pizza page explicitly offers 'Stay n' Hang or Grab n' Go' plus Uber Eats and Skip the Dishes ordering, confirming takeout. Several pizza options state 'With your choice of vegetarian or vegan,' confirming those dietary options. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
